name: vasar-plugins-marketplace
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for everyday development: generic developer workflows with a gated task pipeline, a writing style for technical documents, and a .NET backend toolkit.

plugins.name: dev-essentials
plugins.description: Cross-stack workflows for everyday development with Claude Code. They help you plan, implement, review, and document changes, and keep git and pull requests in order.

plugins.name: doc-styles
plugins.description: A writing style for technical documents. Its skill writes and rewrites docs as Markdown in the style of the OpenBSD manual pages. It starts only when you name that style, and it sets no style for chat replies.

plugins.name: dotnet-backend-dev
plugins.description: Skills, a command, and an agent for .NET backend services that use Clean Architecture, DDD, and EF Core. They create the usual parts of such a service and its tests, and follow one hub of backend conventions. Most templates assume a private shared framework of guard and wrapper types.

plugins.name: kb
plugins.description: Wiring for a personal knowledge base kept in git: session hooks, a write guard, and capture and close skills.
